rows.label: qst003104_msg0001
rows.name:
Are you here to help
with distribution?

rows.label: qst003104_msg0003
rows.name:
This distribution center is short
on dishes made with fish.

rows.label: qst003104_msg0004
rows.name:
If you can prepare some fish dishes,
please bring them here.

rows.label: qst003104_msg0006
rows.name:
Some say it's gotten busier since the
Acedian refugees arrived, but...

rows.label: qst003104_msg0007
rows.name:
I'm a new recruit, and I have my
hands full just looking after myself!

rows.label: qst003104_msg0008
rows.name:
Honestly, I haven't had time
to worry about the refugees!

rows.label: qst003104_msg0009
rows.name:
But thanks to all of you, I have
some breathing room now!

rows.label: qst003104_msg0010
rows.name:
From now on, I want to pay much more
attention to everyone who's in need!

rows.label: qst003104_msg0011
rows.name:
Thank you very much!
I'm truly grateful!
